spectral_scattering.input: Current T1 native long/short logpower float16->float32, no resizing, fixed coefficients, all paths mean/std spatial grid

config.selection: Same source Val guards: original S/D/BG within1pp,5/0 Double within1pp,10ACC within1pp. Eligible first; then mean5/0ACC,mean5/0Single,originalACC. Select actual continuation epochs1..20; epoch0 reference only. If no eligible trained epoch, report actual best and do not adopt. Negative SNR monitored but not ranked; Test only after selection sealed.
config.training: Both strictly inherit F1M1 epoch33 including original Train normalization; same fresh AdamW 3e-5; 20 continuation epochs, paired order/dropout/AWGN directions. Only SNR probabilities differ. Keep existing Single envelope rules, data, class weights, CE+0.1 count marginal. No new front end, loss or classifier mechanism.
config.initialization: Same trained F1M1 epoch33 in both groups, all public parameters continue training; fresh identical optimizer states. Existing trained history is part of this adaptation experiment, not from-scratch architecture comparison.
config.normalization: Keep exact source F1 normalization; no refit on noisy or evaluation data.
config.new_protocol: Two-level distribution shared across all labels: original probability0.5; conditional on augmentation sample five SNR levels uniformly. Probabilities, not exact per-epoch quotas.

normalization_rationale: Exact saved F1M1 original-Train normalization, unchanged in both arms.
